Mode 3 is compared first; attribution modes have not been timed here.\n\n| Route/batch | Matching control | Fully unsafe | Untouched live |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'

 root=s/f'unsafe-code-timing-{scene}-{batch}';rows=json.loads((root/'measurements.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==6

 host=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-code-timing-{scene}-{batch}-host.json').read_text());assert host['returncode']==0
 values={};means={}
 for mode in ['control','unsafe','baseline']:

  values[mode]=[x['measurement']['wall_seconds']for x in selected];means[mode]=statistics.mean(values[mode])
 ratios.append((scene,batch,means,values))

 text+=f"{scene} {batch}: "

  text+=f"versus {ref} {100*(means[ref]/means['unsafe']-1):+.2f}% throughput, corresponding-half pairs {pairs[0]:+.2f}% / {pairs[1]:+.2f}%; "
 text+='\n\n'
text+='These corresponding-half pairs are not all adjacent. Passive host readings and process observations accompany every batch; no observation is normalized or removed. Different older live compiler layout is a separate control. This deliberately unsafe semantic assumption is not suitable for promotion. No deployment or push.\n'
